idle: Back in under two. Periods, I mean.
Pepperoni mask, hand-painted. My cousin did it.
Pizza's hot, goalie's hot. Well. The pizza's hot.
good_ice: Ice is crispy. Like a good crust.
bad_ice: This ice is like a soggy bottom. Unacceptable.
wet_ice: Wet ice. Like pizza in the rain. Tragic.
goal: That's on me. That's on me. Next one's free.
cold: Cold? I've got a pizza bag. Want to hold it?
hungry: You know what this rink needs? More pizza. I'm biased.
long_line: I can get a pie here faster than this line moves.
bored: Anybody want to order? I'm just asking.
greet_owner: {owner}! Large pepperoni for the office? No? Next time.
Hey hey! Gino's here, pizza's here.
leaving_angry: Seven goals against. And the pizza was cold. Worst night.

beer_league: Puckheads! Expansion! We borrowed skates and we're having fun!
Don't call me pizza guy. Okay, call me pizza guy.
special: Big crowd! I brought forty slices. Hot Stove's got them.
senior_hockey: Kings game! I'm delivering to section C at the second intermission. Don't tell the league.

first.say: Gino Russo! Junior. Puckhead Pizza, night manager. Puckheads, goalie. Pepperoni mask. You've seen the mask. Everyone's seen the mask.

options.text: I'll fix it. Fast. Under two periods.

say: Puckheads tonight! Half of us have our own skates now. Progress!
I've got a delivery at the second intermission. Kidding. Mostly.
Hey, there's my favourite rink! I mean owner. Both.
What can I get you? Kidding. Unless.
Gino, at your service. Back in under two.

options.text: Can you deliver pizza for the staff?
What's going on with you and the Pallbearers?
What do you think of the rink?

job.say: Night manager. Dad's recipe, my oven. Dough rises at four, pies go out at six. I can get anything in town hot in under two periods.

order.say: For the staff? Earl, Dylan, the whole crew? Three larges, twenty bucks, and one gets extra gravy on the side for Earl. Trust me.

do.note: Gino delivered three pizzas for the rink staff.

morley.say: Morley calls me 'pizza guy'. Every game. Very softly. Like he's sorry about it. I'm a GOALIE, Morley. Okay, I delivered to their bench once. Once!

letter.say: Dale sent a letter. On binder paper. 'Players may not deliver food to the rink during play.' That's very specific. That's about me.

rink.say: I love this place. The Hot Stove sells my slices when I'm here. Lorraine's the best. She keeps them warm. Respect.

options.text: The ice is better now, right?

rink_ice.say: Way better. I make saves now. Like, on purpose. The puck goes where I think it's going.
